name: vitals-dashboard-e2e
description: Real-browser tests for `vitals dashboard`, run against the actual compiled binary via Playwright's webServer option. Plain-JS test files on purpose -- no TypeScript/build step, matching AGENTS.md's 'one dependency for a real reason' rule. This is the repo's only Node/JS toolchain; it exists specifically for what a Go test asserting on server-rendered HTML strings cannot see: real DOM state after a client-side fetch() resolves, a real button click, real dark-mode rendering, a real browser console error.
